articles.title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
articles.description:

articles.title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
articles.description:
arXiv:2609.21096v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. articles.title_zh: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing

articles.title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
articles.description:
arXiv:2609.21157v1 Announce Type: new
